name: application-breadcrumb-dropdown-overflow
title: Breadcrumb Dropdown Overflow
description: Breadcrumb trail that collapses middle segments into a '…' trigger, opening a dropdown listing the hidden segments, while keeping the first and last two visible.
useWhen: A page's path is deep enough (5+ levels) that a full breadcrumb trail would wrap or overflow its container.
Users still need access to every ancestor page, not just the visible ones.
The first (root) and last two (current context) segments are the most useful to keep always visible.
avoidWhen: The path is shallow (4 or fewer segments) — render the plain breadcrumbs component with no collapsing needed.
Segment order/hierarchy doesn't matter to users — a simple 'Back' link may be clearer than a breadcrumb trail at all.
You need responsive truncation that changes with viewport width — this component collapses by segment count, not container width.
responsiveBehavior: The trail is an inline-sized flex row; combine with your own resize-based logic if you want the collapse threshold to react to container width rather than a fixed segment count.
accessibility: The overflow trigger uses aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded reflecting whether the hidden-segments dropdown is open.
The current page segment is a <span aria-current="page">, not a link, matching breadcrumb accessibility conventions.
Chevron separators are aria-hidden since they're purely visual; the list structure alone conveys the hierarchy to assistive tech.

variants.title: Collapsed
variants.description: Home, a collapsed '…' trigger, then Settings and the current 'API Keys' page.
accessibility: The trigger's aria-label describes its action ('Show hidden breadcrumb segments'), not just '…'.

variants.title: Collapsed (Dark)
variants.description: Collapsed breadcrumb trail adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Link and chevron colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.

variants.title: Overflow open
variants.description: The '…' trigger expanded, showing the hidden Workspace, Acme Corp, and Admin segments in a dropdown.
accessibility: Hidden segments retain their original order in the dropdown, matching the real path hierarchy.

variants.title: Overflow open (Dark)
variants.description: Open overflow dropdown state adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dropdown background and border colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
